name: Israel, Gaza & region
value: Gaza raid ended 19 Nov; Beqaa strikes 20 Nov
summary: Israel ended a Gaza tank raid on 19 Nov and struck Lebanon's Beqaa on 20 Nov; Houthi missile debris hit Riyadh
state: Israel's military said on 19 Nov it had concluded a tank raid west of the Yellow Line in central Gaza and reopened Salahudeen road; Gaza health authorities say at least 1,600 Palestinians have been killed since the October 2025 truce (Reuters via CP24). Medical sources reported three Palestinians killed in Gaza on 19 Nov (Anadolu). Israel struck a former Hezbollah site in the Beqaa on 20 Nov, and debris from a Houthi missile damaged a Riyadh tower on 19 Nov (Gulf News). Fighting on several fronts keeps the Alert.
for_you: British nationals in Israel, the Palestinian territories, Lebanon, Yemen and Saudi Arabia should follow FCDO travel advice, which can change at short notice.
rubric_hit: Alert: multi-front escalation (Gaza ground raid 18–19 Nov, Israeli strikes in Lebanon 20 Nov, Houthi missile on Riyadh 19 Nov)
